summary: FEATURED IMAGE PHASE 2 VALIDATION (baseline v173 + Feature branch). Verified via live preview URL (https://color-task-timer.preview.emergentagent.com) with Playwright + real JPEG upload. VERDICT: **FAIL**. Root cause: FeaturedImageBanner.jsx:76 calls a non-existent method `StorageService.addAttachment(compressed)`. The actual API on StorageService is `saveAttachment(file)` (returns {id,name,type,size}). Console error observed on every upload attempt: `TypeError: _storage_storageService__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_5__.default.addAttachment is not a function at handleFile`. Because handleFile throws, `onChange({attachment_id: meta.id})` is never fired, so note.featured_image is NEVER persisted, filesStore stays empty (never initialized), the hero image never renders — the entire Add / Change flow is dead in the water. Empty-state add button, wiring, testids, isDark styling, hero/chip variants, and diff scope are otherwise implemented correctly; simply swapping the method name to `saveAttachment` should make the feature work end-to-end.

rca_of_the_issue: SYMPTOM: Clicking 'Add Featured Image' → picking a file → nothing renders, no toast, no persistence. CONSOLE: `TypeError: StorageService.addAttachment is not a function at handleFile`. ROOT CAUSE: FeaturedImageBanner.jsx line 76 calls `StorageService.addAttachment(compressed)`, but StorageService (backend of this feature, in storageService.js) exposes `saveAttachment(file)` (line 317) — not `addAttachment`. The method name was chosen inconsistently with the surrounding module. MITIGATION: rename the call site to `saveAttachment`. Return contract is already compatible: both were expected to return `{id, ...}` and the caller only reads `.id`. IMPACT: 100% of Featured Image Phase 2 flows are non-functional in the currently served v174 bundle — both hero (FullScreenNote) and chip (NoteModal) variants.
